work.permit: autorisation individuelle d'emploi du chef de l'Inspection du Travail

note: Majority: null. The Code des obligations et des contrats and the Code du statut personnel were not read; legislation.tn answered 503 and the social affairs ministry didn't answer. Work: Code du travail (Loi n° 66-27 du 30 avril 1966), in the Imprimerie Officielle de la République Tunisienne's 2010 edition (the copy held by the African Mining Legislation Atlas, a-mla.org; the official printer's text, read in that copy): art. 53 (as amended by Loi n° 96-62 du 15 juillet 1996) children under 16 may not be employed in any activity the Code governs, save its special provisions; art. 53-2 vocational training from 14; art. 56 light work from 13 in non-industrial, non-agricultural work, which the form doesn't hold. Amendments after 2010 were not checked. Performers: art. 57 (as amended 1996): in the interest of art, science or teaching, and notwithstanding arts. 53 to 56, the head of the Labour Inspectorate may grant individual employment authorisations for children to appear in public shows or take part as actors or extras in film shoots; an order of the Minister of Social Affairs sets the minimum age from which such authorisations may be granted and the precautions (that order was not read, so permitFrom isn't held); a later article lets those over 14 and under 18 appear in evening shows or night shoots until midnight with fourteen hours' rest. Service: the Ministry of National Defence's page 'الخدمة الوطنية' (defense.tn, read 2026-10-31): national service is a duty under art. 9 of the Constitution, a short period of one year the young man (الشاب) spends in the national army; a one-year renewable deferral may be given to a citizen who has reached 20; exempt are the medically unfit, family breadwinners, those over 28 working and living abroad lawfully, and every citizen over 35. The form holds 20 until 35, 12 months, male (my reading: the page speaks of the young man and every citizen, and doesn't say whether women are called; Loi n° 2004-1 on national service was not read).

sources.title: Code du travail (Loi n° 66-27 du 30 avril 1966), Publications de l'Imprimerie Officielle de la République Tunisienne, 2010 (copy held by the African Mining Legislation Atlas)
sources.said: Les enfants de moins de 16 ans ne peuvent être employés dans toutes les activités régies par le présent code, sous réserve des dispositions spéciales prévues par ce code. ... le chef de l’Inspection du Travail peut accorder des autorisations individuelles d’emploi afin de permettre aux enfants de paraître dans les spectacles publics, ou de participer, comme acteurs ou figurants, à des prises de vue cinématographiques.

sources.title: الخدمة الوطنية، وزارة الدفاع الوطني (الجمهورية التونسية)
sources.said: و هي فترة قصيرة تدوم سنة واحدة يقضيها الشاب في صفوف الجيش الوطني ... يجوز منح تأجيـل أداء الخدمة الوطنية لمدة سنة واحدة قابلة للتجديد لكل مواطن يبلغ من العمر 20 عامًا ... كل مواطن تجاوز سن الخامسة والثلاثين.
